map.数据速率换算器在 bit/s、kbps、Mbps、Gbps 及字节速率间转换，区: The data rate converter converts between bit/s, kbps, Mbps, Gbps and byte rates, distinguishing decimal and binary units, suiting network bandwidth, transfer rate and traffic unit conversion.
map.宽带标称 500 Mbps，换算成下载速度 MB/s 判断实际带宽是否达标。: Broadband is advertised at 500 Mbps — convert to MB/s download speed to judge whether the actual bandwidth meets the plan.
map.bit(b) 与 Byte(B) 差 8 倍。: bit (b) and Byte (B) differ by a factor of 8.
map.为什么 Mbps 和 MB/s 差 8 倍？: Why do Mbps and MB/s differ by a factor of 8?
map.小写 b 表示比特、大写 B 表示字节，1 字节 = 8 比特，因此 MB/s: Lowercase b means bit and uppercase B means byte; 1 byte = 8 bits, so MB/s = Mbps ÷ 8.
